name: Grupo Zen Viento del Sur
reason: Too thin: apart from its zazen schedule (daily on Zoom, Sundays at its dojo in Villa Urquiza, Buenos Aires) the site has no current offerings; the latest sesshin listed is August 2025, its Spanish editions of Robert Aitken carry no ISBN or price, and its YouTube channel (65 subscribers, Data API 11 Nov 2026) has one 2020 talk that fails oEmbed. Contact edojo.zenonline@gmail.com is published. Teacher Daniel Terragno Roshi (see Zen Montanas y Mar, rank 2176). Owner could revisit when a 2026-27 sesshin is posted.
